simple.summary: אַחְרַח (ʼAchrach) means Achrach , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 8 1.

definitions.full: H315. Acharach אַחֲרַח proper name, masculine a son of Benjamin 1Chr 8:1 (perhaps corruption of אֲחִירָם Num 26:38 , compare also אֵחִי ).
